title: Apply fission to distribution
summary: Migrated distribution to exclusive fission ownership: the original factor remains rigid and nonzero through preview, is wholly replaced by both descendants at one geometrically co-located birth event, then descendants depart on semantic-order arcs while addends reflow and grouping retires. Registered the compiler and choreography in the lazy algebra pack to preserve startup budget.
